data.exact_reserve_text: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 37.6m (2014: strengthening of GBP 0.3m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 54.7m (2014: release of GBP 15.8m), and Property and Fire release of GBP 5.3m (2014: release of GBP 3.6m).This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 23.4m (2014: strengthening of GBP 20.8m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall prior-year reserve release of approximately GBP 37.6m in 2015, driven principally by favourable development in Marine (Aviation and Marine) and modest releases in Property/Fire, partially offset by adverse development in Third Party Liability (public liability). The net effect was a release representing roughly a 6.4% reduction on opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 37.6m (2014: strengthening of GBP 0.3m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 54.7m (2014: release of GBP 15.8m), and Property and Fire release of GBP 5.3m (2014: release of GBP 3.6m).This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 23.4m (2014: strengthening of GBP 20.8m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure taken from narrative 'Movement in Prior Year's Provision for Claims' note which explicitly states an approximate gross release of GBP 37.6m. Component LOB figures in the note sum to ~GBP 36.6m (rounding differences). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet (claims outstanding, comparative prior year). Claims development triangle is available and gross; triangle used only for structure, but the reported prior-year movement was taken from the narrative note. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were identified in the narrative.
